title: spec(migrations): the flow-record-read-and-decision-type-mismatch-refused entry's surface names only a time-relative flow sweeping the start node's objectName
body:
domain:server#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6Cbvcmv8YWFhFJwzjKL

Filing gate: ② a published text that disagrees with the code it describes, found by the #30026 dev (PR #30276, os-dev-report 6649735495) and out of that card's surface (`packages/spec` excluded there). ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the grade.
Reader: `domain:spec`, `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.flow-record-read-and-decision-type-mismatch-refused.ts` (`surface`, and the matching sentence in `reason`).
Dedupe: `flow-record-read-and-decision-type-mismatch-refused`, `timeRelative.object` surface → none open. **New.**

## What is wrong

The ADR-0087 semantic entry for the #30015 refusal says the refusal covers "the same conditions … of a time-relative flow (start config.timeRelative) sweeping the start node's objectName". `TimeRelativeTriggerSchema.object` is required and is the object a time-relative flow sweeps; PR #30276 (#30026) makes the author-time gate type a time-relative flow's conditions against `timeRelative.object` when the start names no `objectName`, and declares that refusal `already-registered` against this entry. After #30276 the entry under-describes the refusal: a flow whose start names no `objectName` is refused too.

## Wanted

- [ ] Reword the `surface` (and the `reason` sentence "A time-relative sweep launches each run with the swept row as its record…") to name the swept object as `timeRelative.object`, typed against it when the start names no `objectName`, and against the start's `objectName` when that is the swept object.
- [ ] Land after PR #30276 merges, so the text matches the tree.

Links: #30026, PR #30276, PR #30015, #29959.
